usageNotes: Use this to list all configured SDN IPAM integrations on the cluster, optionally filtered by type (netbox, phpipam, or pve). Requires 'SDN.Audit' or 'SDN.Allocate' permission on '/sdn/ipams/<ipam>' — results are filtered per caller's privileges, so an empty list may mean missing permissions rather than no IPAMs configured. SDN must be enabled and the cluster-wide SDN configuration must be applied before IPAM entries appear.
tips: The built-in 'pve' IPAM type uses Proxmox's own IP tracking and is available without any external integration.
If you expect an IPAM to appear but the list is empty, check your SDN.Audit or SDN.Allocate permission on /sdn/ipams/<ipam> rather than assuming it is unconfigured.
IPAM entries must be committed via the SDN apply step before they are active on nodes.
